c.tagline: 'Florence on the Elbe' — baroque splendour rebuilt stone by stone.

emergency.note: 112 is the EU-wide emergency number for ambulance and fire; 110 reaches the police.

avoid.reason: Pickpockets work Hauptbahnhof and Prager Straße, and occasional Monday-evening political demonstrations are best given a wide berth.

hood_desc: Dresden's reconstructed Baroque showpiece on the south bank of the Elbe, home to the Frauenkirche, Zwinger, Semperoper, Residenzschloss, and the Green Vault; the entire historic core is walkable in under 15 minutes, making it the obvious base for first-timers.

The elegant 'inner new town' across the Augustus Bridge, centered on the Baroque Königstraße quarter with its boutiques and upscale dining and the Golden Rider statue; a refined, central place to stay just steps from the river.

The gritty, bohemian 'outer new town' — Dresden's alternative heart, packed with bars, clubs, street art, and the whimsical Kunsthofpassage courtyards; a student-and-creative crowd and the city's best nightlife.

A quiet, leafy residential district east of the center lined with villas and Gründerzeit apartment blocks; local and calm, popular with families and travelers wanting a relaxed base a short tram ride from the sights.

An upscale villa quarter along the Elbe in the east, home to the landmark Blue Wonder (Blaues Wunder) bridge, riverside beer gardens, and leafy calm; a peaceful stay with river views away from the crowds.

water.note: Tap water is safe and of high quality throughout the city.

transit.hours: Trams and buses run roughly 4:30am-1am; on Friday and Saturday nights the GuteNachtLinie network runs through the small hours, with hourly night buses filling gaps midweek.
transit.pay: Buy tickets in the DVB mobil or VVO mobil app or from platform/vehicle machines (cards accepted) and validate before or on boarding; one ticket covers trams, buses, and the S-Bahn. A single ticket is about €3 (~$3.25) and a day ticket about €8. Staying weeks? The €58/month Deutschland-Ticket covers local transit nationwide.

bus: Dresden Central Bus Station (ZOB, beside Hauptbahnhof)

transit.m: S-Bahn S2 to Dresden Hauptbahnhof (~20 min, every 30 min)

tip.r: 5-10% or round up the bill; tell the server the total you want to pay when you hand over the money.
